title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the first protocol that embeds trustworthiness directly into navigation systems, ensuring safety and reliability in real-world AI.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential because without measurable standards, NavTrust can’t prove its claims—how do you know it's actually trustworthy?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust uses real-world data from thousands of robots, validated through rigorous safety protocols and failure mode analysis.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking allows for transparency and comparison—without it, NavTrust is just a black box with no way to verify or improve performance.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust isn’t just a benchmark—it’s the blueprint for future safe, reliable, and scalable embodied AI.
